```{r lib_load}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling & ggplot2
library(janitor)     # functions for examining and cleaning dirty data
```

```{r fun, results='hide'}
codf    <- readRDS(file = here("rmds/modfunctions", "codfunctions.rds"))
codform <- readRDS(file = here("rmds", "codformulas.rds"))
codf_env <- list2env(codf, parent = globalenv())
for (nm in names(codf)) {environment(codf[[nm]]) <- codf_env}
list2env(codf, envir = codf_env)
source(here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/d2325f", "spss_cod_district-1_23-25f.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r setup1}
# User inputs
data_path <- here("data/city", "CCD1_2023-2025_Data.sav")  
output_dir <- here("data/city/outs")
# dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ecf_keep <- NULL       # Optional: add ECF filters here if needed, e.g. c("1R101", "1R102")
base_ecf <- "1r135"    # Base ECF in the SPSS syntax
```

```{r prepdata}
#df <- read_sav(data_path) |> rename_with(tolower)    # Load data
df <- read_csv(here("data/city", "salesSFapr2023toMarch2025Updated.csv")) |>
  rename_with(tolower) |> filter(ccd == 1)
dfspss <- read_csv(here("data/spss", "spssmods.csv"))
dfsps <- read_csv(here("data/spss", "spsscos.csv"))
# Initial review / filters
df <- df |> filter(ccd == 1)    # Equivalent to: SELECT IF CCD=1.
if (!is.null(ecf_keep)) {df <- df |> filter(ecf %in% ecf_keep)}    # Optional ECF filter block

df <- df |>    # Price categories
  mutate(
    priceclass = case_when(
      saleprice < 45000 ~ 1L, saleprice >= 45000 & saleprice < 80000 ~ 2L,
      saleprice >= 80000 & saleprice < 115000 ~ 3L,
      saleprice >= 115000 & saleprice < 180000 ~ 4L,
      saleprice >= 180000 & saleprice < 250000 ~ 5L, saleprice >= 250000 ~ 6L, TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

df <- df |>    # Record filtering
  mutate(
    inn = ifelse(sresb_style %in% c("SINGLE FAMILY", "1/2 DUPLEX", "ROW HOUSE"), 1L, 0L)
  ) |> filter(inn == 1)

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    out = ifelse(
      stotalsqft < 400 |
      sresb_floorarea < 400 |
      saleprice < 10000,
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) |> filter(out == 0)
# Remove duplicates: SPSS kept the "last" record by parcelno, saleprice, saledate
df <- df |>
  mutate(saledate_parsed = parse_sale_date(saledate)) |>
  arrange(parcelno, saleprice, saledate_parsed) |>
  group_by(parcelno, saleprice, saledate) |>
  mutate(primarylast = if_else(row_number() == n(), 1L, 0L)) |>
  ungroup() |> filter(primarylast == 1)

df <- df |>    # Remove likely non-market sales where sale price ~= assessment
  mutate(
    priceisasmt_ratio = avwhensold / saleprice,
    priceisasmt_ratio2 = ifelse(priceisasmt_ratio >= 0.90 & priceisasmt_ratio <= 1.10, 1, priceisasmt_ratio),
    priceisasmt_ratio = priceisasmt_ratio2, priceisasmt = ifelse(priceisasmt_ratio == 1, 0L, 1L)
  ) |> filter(priceisasmt == 1)
# Setup calculations
df <- df |> mutate(ratio = sesttcv / saleprice, sppsf = saleprice / sresb_floorarea)
# Categorical binary transformations
df <- df |>    # Style-height buckets
  mutate(
    onestory      = ifelse(sresb_styhgt <= 2, 1L, 0L),
    twostory      = ifelse(sresb_styhgt > 2 & sresb_styhgt <= 5, 1L, 0L),
    twoplusstory  = ifelse(sresb_styhgt > 5 & sresb_styhgt <= 8, 1L, 0L),
    bilevelsplit  = ifelse(sresb_styhgt > 8 & sresb_styhgt <= 10, 1L, 0L),
    check = onestory + twostory + twoplusstory + bilevelsplit,
    # Base per syntax comment: SINGLE_FAMILY1STORY
    single_family2story = ifelse(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & twostory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    half_duplex1story   = ifelse(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" & onestory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    half_duplex2story   = ifelse(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" & twostory == 1, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |>    # Building eras
  mutate(
    erabuilt = case_when(
      sresb_yearbuilt < 1910 ~ 1L, sresb_yearbuilt >= 1910 & sresb_yearbuilt < 1930 ~ 2L,
      sresb_yearbuilt >= 1930 & sresb_yearbuilt < 1946 ~ 3L,
      sresb_yearbuilt >= 1946 & sresb_yearbuilt < 1961 ~ 4L,
      sresb_yearbuilt >= 1961 & sresb_yearbuilt <= 1990 ~ 5L,
      sresb_yearbuilt > 1990 ~ 6L, TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    yb_pre_1910 = ifelse(erabuilt == 1, 1L, 0L), yb_1910_to_1929 = ifelse(erabuilt == 2, 1L, 0L),
    yb_1930_to_1945 = ifelse(erabuilt == 3, 1L, 0L), yb_1961_to_1990 = ifelse(erabuilt == 5, 1L, 0L),
    yb_post_1990 = ifelse(erabuilt == 6, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |>    # Condition
  mutate(
    good = ifelse(scond == 2, 1L, 0L), fair = ifelse(scond == 4, 1L, 0L),
    poor = ifelse(scond == 5, 1L, 0L), unsound = ifelse(scond == 7, 1L, 0L),
    cavg = ifelse(scond == 3, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |>    # Bathrooms
  mutate(
    two_baths        = ifelse(sresb_fullbaths == 2, 1L, 0L),
    three_plus_baths = ifelse(sresb_fullbaths %in% 3:10, 1L, 0L),
    powder_room      = ifelse(sresb_halfbaths %in% 1:5, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |> mutate(fireplace = ifelse(sresb_fireplace %in% 1:6, 1L, 0L))    # Fireplace

df <- df |>    # Basement/crawl/slab
  mutate(
    pctcrawl = sresb_crawspace / sresb_groundarea,
    pctslab  = sresb_slabarea / sresb_groundarea,
    pctbsmnt = sresb_basementarea / sresb_groundarea,
    crawl    = ifelse(pctcrawl > pctbsmnt & pctcrawl > pctslab, 1L, 0L),
    slab     = ifelse(pctslab > pctcrawl & pctslab > pctbsmnt, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |>    # Building class
  mutate(
    qbest      = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 5, 1L, 0L), qavg = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 2, 1L, 0L),
    qabove_avg = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass %in% c(3, 4), 1L, 0L),
    qbelow_avg = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 1, 1L, 0L), qpoor = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 0, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |>    # Garages
  mutate(
    garage = ifelse(sresb_garagearea >= 200, 1L, 0L),
    garagespaces = case_when(
      sresb_garagearea > 200 & sresb_garagearea < 420 ~ 1,
      sresb_garagearea > 419 & sresb_garagearea < 600 ~ 2,
      sresb_garagearea > 599 & sresb_garagearea < 820 ~ 3, sresb_garagearea > 819 ~ 4, TRUE ~ 0
    ), ln_garagespaces = safe_log(garagespaces)
  )

df <- df |> mutate(arterial = ifelse(rd_class %in% c("A21", "A31"), 1L, 0L))    # Road class

df <- df |>    # Heating/cooling
  mutate(
    hot_water = ifelse(sresb_heat == 2, 1L, 0L), elec_baseboard = ifelse(sresb_heat == 3, 1L, 0L),
    wall = ifelse(sresb_heat %in% c(6, 8), 1L, 0L), central_air = ifelse(sresb_heat == 9, 1L, 0L)
  )
# Size buckets # NOTE: The SPSS syntax uses "< 12666" for size=3, which looks like a typo.
# Here I use 1266 because that is consistent with the other cutpoints.
df <- df |>
  mutate(
    size = case_when(
      sresb_floorarea < 830 ~ 1L, sresb_floorarea >= 830 & sresb_floorarea < 1018 ~ 2L,
      sresb_floorarea >= 1018 & sresb_floorarea < 1266 ~ 3L,
      sresb_floorarea >= 1266 & sresb_floorarea < 1659 ~ 4L,
      sresb_floorarea >= 1659 ~ 5L, TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    smallest = ifelse(size == 1, 1L, 0L), small = ifelse(size == 2, 1L, 0L),
    large    = ifelse(size == 4, 1L, 0L), largest = ifelse(size == 5, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df |>    # Time analysis setup
  mutate(
    smonth = month(saledate_parsed), syear = year(saledate_parsed),
    months = case_when(
      syear == 2023 ~ smonth - 3, syear == 2024 ~ smonth + 9,
      syear == 2025 ~ smonth + 21, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
# NOTE: # The SPSS syntax says:
#   RECODE scond (4=1)(ELSE=0) INTO average. # Earlier value labels say 3 = Average and 4 = Fair.
# To preserve the SPSS text exactly, use scond == 4 below.
df2 <- df |> mutate(average = ifelse(scond == 4, 1L, 0L))

df_avg <- df2 |> filter(average == 1) |>
  mutate(
    sppsf = saleprice / sresb_floorarea, months_1to9 = pmin(months, 9),
    months_10to18 = case_when(
      months > 9  & months <= 18 ~ months - 9, months > 18 ~ 9, TRUE ~ 0
    ), months_19to24 = case_when(months > 18 ~ months - 18, TRUE ~ 0),
    ln_sppsf = safe_log(sppsf)
  )

df <- df |>    # Add time spline vars to full data too
  mutate(
    months_1to9 = pmin(months, 9),
    months_10to18 = case_when(
      months > 9  & months <= 18 ~ months - 9, months > 18 ~ 9, TRUE ~ 0
    ), months_19to24 = case_when(months > 18 ~ months - 18, TRUE ~ 0), ln_sppsf = safe_log(sppsf)
  )
```

---

## Model I

```{r mod1}
# Time model
time_terms <- c(
  "arterial",
  "single_family2story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "unsound",
  "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1910", "yb_1910_to_1929", "yb_1930_to_1945", "yb_1961_to_1990", "yb_post_1990",
  "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  "months_1to9", "months_10to18", "months_19to24"
)

time_formula <- reformulate(time_terms, response = "ln_sppsf")
mod_time <- backward_pss(time_formula, data = df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE) # df_avg

#model_summary_tbl(mod_time)
# write_csv(broom::tidy(mod_time), file.path(output_dir, "ccd1_time_model_coefficients.csv"))
# write_csv(model_summary_tbl(mod_time), file.path(output_dir, "ccd1_time_model_summary.csv"))
```

```{r src1}
rmt <- model_metrics_c(mod_time, digits = 4)
smod1 <- dfspss |> filter(spssmod == "ccd1mod1") |> select(df_total:f_stat)
res <- make_metrics_kable(spss_df = smod1, r_df = rmt,
  caption = "District 1 | LN\\_SPPSF Model Fit Statistics: SPSS vs R"
)
#res$data
res$kable
```

```{r coef1}
spsmod1 <- dfsps |> filter(codd == 1 & model == 1) |> select(model:sig) |>
  mutate(term = trimws(tolower(term)), term = ifelse(term == "(constant)", "(intercept)", term))

m1c <- make_coeff_compare_tabl(
  model = mod_time, spss_df = spsmod1, include_intercept = TRUE, intercept_first = TRUE,
  digits = 3, caption = "District 1 | Model I Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R"
)

m1c$kable
```

```{r rbs1}
spsmod1a <- spsmod1
spsmod1a$term <- tolower(spsmod1$term)

res_compare1 <- codf$plot_beta_compare_lollipops(
  model = mod_time, df = spsmod1a, df_term_col = "term", df_beta_col = "beta",
  include_ecf = FALSE, model_label = "R", df_label = "SPSS",
  title = "District 1 | Model I Beta Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R"
)

res_compare1$plot
```

```{r timeadj1}
dfrate1 <- make_time_adjusted_df(df, mod_time, time_formula)

df <- df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    rate1_initial = dfrate1$rate1, rate2_initial = dfrate1$rate2, rate3_initial = dfrate1$rate3,
    price_index_initial = dfrate1$price_index, end_index_initial = dfrate1$end_index,
    taf_initial = dfrate1$taf, tasp_initial = dfrate1$tasp,
    tasppsf_initial = dfrate1$tasppsf, ln_tasp_initial = dfrate1$ln_tasp
  )
```

```{r updatedata1}
df <- df |>    # Building size transformations
  mutate(
    lnsbldsf = safe_log(sresb_floorarea), sbldsfint = sresb_floorarea - 541,
    lnsbldsfint = safe_log(sresb_floorarea - 541), sbldsfmed = sresb_floorarea - 1104,
    lnsbldsfmed = safe_log(sresb_floorarea - 1104)
  )

df <- df |>    # Style-specific base building sizes from the syntax
  mutate(
    base_bldgsize = case_when(
      sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" ~ 1108, sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" ~ 842, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), base_bldgsize_ratio = sresb_floorarea / base_bldgsize,
    ln_base_bldgsize_ratio = safe_log(base_bldgsize_ratio),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_single = ifelse(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_halfduplex = ifelse(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0)
  )

df <- df |>    # Lot size / land ratio
  mutate(
    base_lotsize = case_when(
      sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" ~ 5184, sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" ~ 3006,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), base_lotsize_ratio = stotalsqft / base_lotsize,
    ln_base_lotsize_ratio = safe_log(base_lotsize_ratio),
    landratio = stotalsqft / base_lotsize,
    landratio2 = ifelse(landratio >= 0.90 & landratio <= 1.10, 1, landratio),
    landratio2 = ifelse(sresb_style != "SINGLE FAMILY" & landratio > 3, 3, landratio2),
    landratio2 = ifelse(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & landratio > 4, 4, landratio2),
    ln_landratio = safe_log(landratio2)
  )
```

## Model II

```{r mod2}
# Regression without ECFs
df <- df |> mutate(ln_price = safe_log(saleprice), ln_tasp_initial = safe_log(tasp_initial))

base_terms_no_ecf <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio",
  "arterial",
  "single_family2story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "unsound",
  "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1910", "yb_1910_to_1929", "yb_1930_to_1945", "yb_1961_to_1990", "yb_post_1990",
  "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  "months_1to9", "months_10to18", "months_19to24"
)

mod_no_ecf <- backward_pss(
  reformulate(base_terms_no_ecf, response = "ln_price"), data = df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE
)
#model_summary_tbl(mod_no_ecf)
```

```{r src2}

res$kable
```

```{r ecfsetupandcmatrix}
# ecf dummies
df <- make_ecf_dummies(df, base_ecf = base_ecf)
ecf_terms <- paste0("ecf1r", sprintf("%03d", setdiff(101:137, 135)))

# Correlation matrix of candidate predictors
corr_terms <- c(base_terms_no_ecf[!base_terms_no_ecf %in% "months_19to24"], ecf_terms, "months_19to24")
corr_df <- df |> select(any_of(corr_terms))
corr_mat <- suppressWarnings(cor(corr_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
```

## Model III

```{r mod3}
# Base model with ECFs
base_terms_with_ecf <- c(base_terms_no_ecf[!base_terms_no_ecf %in% c()], ecf_terms)

mod_1 <- backward_p(
  reformulate(base_terms_with_ecf, response = "ln_price"), data = df,
  p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE
)

df <- add_influence_metrics(df, mod_1, run_id = 1)
df <- df |> mutate(esp1 = exp(pre_1), ratio1 = esp1 / saleprice)
# ratio_outputs_1_df <- make_ratio_outputs_df(ratio_outputs_1)
# ratio_outputs_1_df |> knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Ratio Study Outputs")
# ratio_stats(df$esp1, df$saleprice)
# model_summary_tbl(mod_1)
rmetrics3 <- codf$spss_ratio_metrics(df, esp1, saleprice)
rmetrics3a <- rmetrics3 |> select(median_ratio:PRB)
```

```{r outremove}
# Outlier removal by Cook's distance and studentized residuals
n_model_1 <- nrow(df)
df <- df |>
  dplyr::mutate(in_inlier = dplyr::if_else(coo_1 > (4 / n_model_1) | abs(sdr_1) > 2, 0L, 1L))

df_in <- df |> filter(in_inlier == 1)
```

```{r mod4}

  reformulate(base_terms_with_ecf, response = "ln_price"),
```

## Model V

```{r mod5}
# Regression with recalibrated time adjustments (no explicit time vars)
base_terms_recal <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio",
  "arterial",
  "single_family2story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "unsound",
  "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1910", "yb_1910_to_1929", "yb_1930_to_1945", "yb_1961_to_1990", "yb_post_1990",
  "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  ecf_terms
)

mod_3 <- backward_p(
  reformulate(base_terms_recal, response = "ln_tasp_recal"),
  data = df_in, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE
)

df_in <- add_influence_metrics(df_in, mod_3, run_id = 3)
df_in <- df_in |> mutate(esp3 = exp(pre_3), ratio3 = esp3 / tasp_recal)
# ratio_stats(df_in$esp3, df_in$tasp_recal)
#model_summary_tbl(mod_3)
sigmafive <- summary(mod_3)$sigma
df_in$spss_ratio_scale <- 1 / exp(0.5 * sigmafive^2)
rmetrics5 <- codf$all_ratio_metrics(df_in, esp3, saleprice, adjust_to_spss = TRUE)
rmetrics5a <- rmetrics5 |> select(median_ratio:PRB)
```

## Model VI

```{r mod6}
# Alternative recalibrated model:
# use garage instead of ln_garagespaces, use lnsbldsfint instead of ln_base_bldgsize_ratio
alt_terms <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "lnsbldsfint",
  "arterial",
  "single_family2story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "good", "fair", "poor", "unsound",
  "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg",
  "yb_pre_1910", "yb_1910_to_1929", "yb_1930_to_1945", "yb_1961_to_1990", "yb_post_1990",
  "crawl", "slab",
  "garage", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "elec_baseboard", "wall", "central_air",
  ecf_terms
)

mod_4 <- backward_pss(
  reformulate(alt_terms, response = "ln_tasp_recal"), data = df_in, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE
)

df_in <- add_influence_metrics(df_in, mod_4, run_id = 4)
df_in <- df_in |> mutate(esp4 = exp(pre_4), ratio4 = esp4 / tasp_recal, modmv = esp4)
sigmasix <- summary(mod_4)$sigma
df_in$spss_ratio_scale <- 1 / exp(0.5 * sigmasix^2)

rmetrics6 <- codf$all_ratio_metrics(df_in, esp4, saleprice, adjust_to_spss = TRUE)
rmetrics6a <- rmetrics6 |> select(median_ratio:PRB)
```

```{r glm1, eval=FALSE}

)

coef(cvfit, s = "lambda.min")
```
